title: Agentic token lifecycle (as described, not a published state model)

states.label: Agent registered
states.note: Public key in the Mastercard key directory.

states.label: Agent certified
states.note: Security review passed; on the trusted agent list.

states.label: Consumer authorized
states.note: Consumer authenticated (passkeys in regional pilots) and set limits.

states.label: Presented at checkout
states.note: Typed into a card form or sent through a merchant API.

states.label: Declined
states.note: Issuer or network declined. Response codes are not published.

states.label: Expired or no longer usable
states.note: Inferred from time-limited and single-use tokens. Mastercard publishes no revocation API or state names.

transitions.trigger: Consumer authenticates with the platform and authorizes the agent
Agent fills the card form or calls the merchant API
Outside token limits or issuer declines
Time window passes or single use consumed
Single-use token cannot be used again
